column1: # P/05 admission by a matched OpenAPI operation. Literal TAB, no CSV quoting. No unmatched path/method is admitted by this table.
# roles is a closed comma-separated set; <sub>worker expands only over manifests in the loaded catalogue. * is any authenticated kit role, never anonymous or an unverified certificate.
# Role filtering applies in mtls mode. The declared loopback mode keeps the admission of common/contracts/role-certificate.md; it does not fabricate a certificate role.

# The TLS chain, serial/revocation, role and CN/SAN checks remain common/contracts/role-certificate.md. The table is a pre-handler role check after operation matching, not a replacement for the TLS handshake.
# A refused role uses ResourceDenied from the OpenAPI. A TLS failure has no invented HTTP status/body. Common404/405 routing remains the OpenAPI/prose rule.
